entities.name: Notification procedure in the UE
entities.description: Procedure executed by the UE when receiving a NOTIFICATION message, where the ESM protocol entity provides the notification indicator to the upper layer.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message received by the UE that triggers the notification procedure.

entities.name: Notification indicator
entities.description: Information element provided by the ESM protocol entity to the upper layer, indicating specific network conditions.

entities.name: SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required
entities.description: Specific condition indicated by the notification indicator value #1, signaling that SRVCC handover was cancelled and IMS session re-establishment is needed.

relations.description: The notification procedure is triggered by receiving the NOTIFICATION message.
The procedure establishes the notification indicator to be provided to the upper layer.
The notification indicator can have the value indicating SRVCC handover cancelled condition.
